title: The Big C
coreMove: Find the chronic threat signal in the room and remove one source of permanent alarm before asking for candor.
sourcePressure: Isolates the chronic alarm force that keeps people braced, making truth, trust, and cooperation bend toward self-protection.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating pressure itself as bad, or diagnosing individual anxiety while ignoring environmental signals.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: forecast lead under constant emergency alerts
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the lead changes the alert tone rules so only true escalation gets the red siren
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a wall speaker above a buoy forecast chart

exampleSpecs.stakes: staff grow guarded and hide small mistakes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the owner removes the surprise checklist and asks for one disclosed risk at the start of prep
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a sanitizer test strip drying near the sink

exampleSpecs.audience: clerk supervisor with a volatile docket
exampleSpecs.stakes: clerks treat every family as a threat
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the supervisor moves security briefings after intake so the first signal is service, not alarm
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a numbered ticket dispenser at a glass window

exampleSpecs.audience: guide team seeing yellow warnings all month
exampleSpecs.stakes: constant caution turns into numbness and silence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the lead separates routine yellow notes from the one slope report that requires a full stop
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an avalanche bulletin clipped to a ski pole

exampleSpecs.stakes: alert fatigue causes real warnings to blur
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she asks the team to predict which popups changed action, then turns off duplicate nonactionable alerts

exampleSpecs.audience: transport coordinator texting urgent updates all night
exampleSpecs.stakes: volunteers stop reading because every text feels like crisis
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she creates a single red-channel rule and moves routine updates to the morning sheet
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a van key clipped to a transport manifest

skillTargets: separate useful pressure from chronic alarm
predict trust erosion under constant alarm

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one recurring alert, meeting, or metric and ask what threat it keeps broadcasting after the useful signal is gone.
